summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in the executor_pattern method_family focused on task submission and result retrieval. It does not semantically match any existing skill (which are in reward_engineering and reward_function_design domains). Peer candidates (Executor Shutdown, URL Fetch, Future Result Retrieval) represent complementary executor-pattern skills at the same granularity level, confirming this is a new capability in the parallel_execution task family.
